messages:
DeployBot: [DEPLOY INITIATED] rolling to dedicated-apac1-private - tag: v2.3.1-hotfix. Commit: abf3c9e. Initiated by: marta. Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-22:30 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 3m watch.

Marta: Kicking off. Observability runbook is pinned in the thread: https://stacks/release/1829. I'll watch latency and error-rate.

Anya: I'll be on call for model infra, watching GPU OOM and queue depth. I'll alert if tail latency > 150ms.

DeployBot: STEP 1/4: Canary 5% applied to pool: ded-apac1-canary-1. Status: queued -> in-progress.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window approved by release-scheduler. :white_check_mark: 

Santiago: Running quick smoke: generate 50 tokens with the new tag. If hallucination regression > baseline, we'll pause.

DeployBot: STEP 2/4: Canary 25% applied. Health checks: 200/200 OK. Avg p95 latency: 88ms (+3ms). No errors.

infra-oncall: Noting a small increase in memory on node g4-13. Draining a pod to check. Will update in 3m.

Marta: Good catch. Pinning v2.2.9 fallback route in case we need to rollback: route: fallback:v2.2.9 (manual pin).

DeployBot: STEP 3/4: Gradual rollout to 60%. Autoscaler ticked up 2 instances. Observability shows stable CPU and queue latency.

Anya: Doing a targeted eval against canned prompts now. Sending results in thread.

Anya: Eval: 200 prompts - quality delta: +0.4% (better). No major regressions.

DeployBot: STEP 4/4: Completing rollout to 100%. Post-deploy hooks running (migrations, cache warm). ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: Postdeploy sanity checks configured: svc-health, kv-check, embed-consistency.

Marta: If anything > 5% error in 10m, we rollback to fallback:v2.2.9. Agree? :thumbsup: 

Santiago: Agree. I'll start the rollback playbook doc if we hit that threshold.

DeployBot: DEPLOY COMPLETE: tag v2.3.1-hotfix deployed to dedicated-apac1-private. Status: SUCCESS. Commit: abf3c9e. Duration: 12m.

Marta: Nice. Postdeploy notes: warmed caches, one pod restarted during canary, memory spike resolved after drain. I'll open a short follow-up ticket for the node.

infra-oncall: Marking incident false-positive. No lasting infra impact. :white_check_mark: 

Anya: Uploading eval CSV and diff plots to the release folder.

Marta: Thanks team. Closing window. Anyone want to add anything before I archive the change? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
